decisions.title: Peter's Escape and Herod's Death
decisions.reason: Describe the people’s acclamation and the stated reason for the judgment without adding a separate act of worship (12:22–23).

published.title: Peter's Escape and Herod's Death
published.summary: Herod kills James and imprisons Peter, whom an angel frees. Later the people acclaim Herod’s speech as the voice of a god; he is struck by an angel because he does not give God the glory, and dies.

decisions.reason: The earthquake opens the prison, but Paul and Silas remain until the magistrates release them (16:26–40).

published.title: Paul in Philippi
published.summary: Timothy joins Paul, who is called to Macedonia. In Philippi Lydia believes, and Paul and Silas are imprisoned. An earthquake opens the prison doors, the jailer is baptized, and the magistrates order their release the next day.
